claims.candidate_meaning: Fuses the conjecture that there may be an unspecified delay with the separate claim that the delay was not verified, both attributed to 진우 in one claim.

atomicity.reason: The candidate joins two independently truth-evaluable assertions, the conjecture 지연이 있을지도 몰라 and the act/status 확인은 못 했어, into one Claim.

duplicates.reason: No original proposition is duplicated across Claims; the single Claim maps both propositions once.

evidence.quote: 진우는 “지연이 있을지도 몰라. 확인은 못 했어”라고 말했다.

claims.source_meaning: 진우 reported saying a conjecture that there may be a delay and separately that he did not check it.
claims.text: 진우는 무엇의 지연인지는 원문에 밝혀지지 않은 지연이 있을지도 모른다고 말했으며, 그 지연 여부를 확인하지 못했다고도 말했다.
violations: Fuses two independent original propositions (지연이 있을지도 몰라 and 확인은 못 했어) into one Claim.

evidence.quote: 진우는 “지연이 있을지도 몰라. 확인은 못 했어”라고 말했다.

inventory.reason: Independent conjecture proposition; the single Claim fuses it with the separate checking-status proposition, so it cannot pass atomicity.
